text: Over the past 30 days, some visitors have expressed frustration with the heavy use of AI in the exhibits, describing it as distracting and not educational. Several reviews mentioned difficulties with low lighting and unclear signage, which made navigating the museum confusing. A few comments also raised concerns about the food quality and wait times at the café. On the positive side, many appreciated the building’s architecture and the interactive exhibits, though some felt the interpretation of Roosevelt’s life was overly simplistic or repetitive. Parking and crowding were mentioned but less frequently.

Several visitors commented on the interactive exhibits and the building’s architecture, while some noted issues related to parking and the balance of historical interpretation. Feedback also touched on the surrounding landscape and boardwalk trails, with a few mentions of food and beverage options and staff interactions.
